mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `user_email` AS `userEmail`, `total_price` AS `totalPrice`, `status`, `created_at` AS `createdAt`, `receiver_name` AS `receiverName`, `receiver_phone` AS `receiverPhone`, `address`, `address_detail` AS `addressDetail`, `request`, `payment_key` AS `paymentKey`, `paid_at` AS `paidAt` FROM `cors`.`orders` WHERE `id` = #{id}

SELECT `t1`.`id` AS `id`, `t1`.`item_id` AS `itemId`, `t3`.`item_name` AS `itemName`, `t1`.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, `t1`.`size` AS `size` , `t1`.`price` AS `price`, `t2`.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, `t1`.`status` AS `status`, (SELECT `img`.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` AS `img` WHERE `img`.`product_id` = `t3`.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`order_items` AS `t1` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`orders` AS `t2` ON `t1`.order_id = `t2`.id LEFT JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` AS `t3` ON `t1`.`item_id` = `t3`.`id` WHERE `t2`.`user_email` = #{userEmail} AND `t2`.`status` != 'PENDING' ORDER BY `createdAt` DESC
